    Gets victim-level data from the FBI's National Incident-Based Reporting System (NIBRS)

    Source: R/nibrs.R
    get_nibrs_victim.Rd

    Retrieves victim demographics (age, race, sex, ethnicity, relationship, location) from the CDE API endpoint `nibrs/level/offense?type=totals`.

    get_nibrs_victim(
  ori = NULL,
  state_abb = NULL,
  from = "01-2015",
  to = "12-2020",
  offense = "robbery",
  variable = "race"
)

    Arguments

    ori

    A string of the 9-character ORI code for the desired agency.

    state_abb

    String for state abbreviation. If `NULL` (default) returns national data.

    from

    Start date in MM-YYYY format (default "01-2015").

    to

    End date in MM-YYYY format (default "12-2020").

    offense

    Offense code (default "robbery"). See `list_nibrs_offenses()` for available codes.

    variable

    A string with the demographic variable to return. Selects which sub-object within the victim section to use (e.g., "age", "race", "sex", "ethnicity", "relationship", "location"). By default returns total count of victims. See `list_nibrs_victim_variables()` for available options.

    Value

    A data.frame with columns: geography, offense, period, demographic_type, demographic_value, count

    See also

    Other NIBRS functions: get_nibrs_offender(), get_nibrs_offense(), list_nibrs_offender_variables(), list_nibrs_offense_variables(), list_nibrs_offenses(), list_nibrs_victim_variables(), list_regions()

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
get_nibrs_victim(ori = "CA0010900")
get_nibrs_victim(state_abb = "CA", offense = "murder", variable = "race")
} # }
